messages:
support-liam: FYI customer BrightCart reported repeated 429s and increased tail latency on their Dedicated pool this morning. They say it happens every ~3-5 minutes for a 30s window. Logs attached.
sre_jamie: ugh, sounds like autoscale oscillation. can you paste the scaling event times + any error snippets?
support-liam: here are excerpts from their support bundle:\n\n-- errors --\n2026-03-15T09:02:14Z 429 TooManyRequests route=generate model=rw/gpt-13 ded_pool=brightcart-pool\n2026-03-15T09:05:18Z 200 OK but latency 850ms\n2026-03-15T09:07:49Z 429 TooManyRequests\n\n-- scaling events (customer telemetry) --\n09:01:50 scale_up to 6 replicas\n09:04:30 scale_down to 3 replicas\n09:06:10 scale_up to 6 replicas\n09:09:00 scale_down to 3 replicas\n\nThey've got min=3, max=12, cooldown=60s, target_util=0.65.\n
eng-maya: thanks. do we see anything on our side? @monitoring-bot can you paste recent metrics for brightcart-pool (gpu_util, inflight, queue_length)
monitoring-bot: PromQL snapshot for brightcart-pool (last 15m):\n- avg(gpu_util) = 48% (spikes to 82% during bursts)\n- inflight_requests: baseline 30 -> spike 120 -> drop to 12\n- avg_queue_length: spikes 70 -> drops under 5 after scale_up\n- request_latency_p95: 420ms -> 980ms during spikes\n
runtime-olav: looks like rapid spikes of incoming QPS that push queue up, trigger scale_up, then QPS drops and we scale_down before cache/KV warmup stabilizes. 60s cooldown too short for model warm-up amortization.
product-aya: customer reported interleaved batch patterns (many short requests) from their webhook fanout. so traffic is bursty and ephemeral.
sre_jamie: root cause hypothesis = noisy traffic pattern + aggressive cooldown => scale churning. also autoscale decision based on instant util metric without hysteresis.
eng-maya: can we reproduce? maya will run a replay tool against a staging pool with the same burstiness.
eng-maya: repro plan: run a 3m script with interleaved bursts: 90s high qps (peak to 120 reqs) then drop to 10 reqs for 2m, repeat. will attach script.\n
eng-maya: quick snippet of the load generator:```bash
for i in {1..6}; do 
  ./send_burst.sh --qps 120 --duration 90; 
  sleep 120;
done
```\n
runtime-olav: proposed mitigations:
1) Increase cooldown to 180s to avoid immediate scale down when short-lived bursts happen.
2) Add a short-term HPA hysteresis window (avg over 30s) instead of instant util.
3) Add "warm pool" option: keep 2 warm replicas above min to absorb spikes.
4) Consider request-level prefetch/pooling on customer side (ask BrightCart to batch webhooks a bit).

sre_jamie: let's try (1) + (2) as a quick config change, roll to their pool as a canary, and monitor for the next 30m. if still flapping, enable warm pool.
support-liam: customer ok with testing config change; they can be on standby for slight capacity changes.
eng-maya: applied to staging repro: cooldown=180s, util_window=30s. running replay now. initial results: after first spike, scale_up to 6, then stayed at 6 for 3m, avg latency stabilized ~430ms. no rapid scale_down.
sre_jamie: good sign. schedule a 15m canary window on prod pool with these settings. who will own rollback?
runtime-olav: i'll own rollout + rollback. plan: patch policy, 10-min Canary on brightcart-pool, monitor inflight & 429s. rollback if 429 rate > 0.5% or p95 latency > 1s.
product-aya: pinging customer to align start time 09:45 UTC.
autoscale-bot: WARNING: policy-change queued -> cool_down: 60s -> 180s, eval_window: instant -> 30s, schedule: immediate canary for pool=brightcart-pool (10min)
support-liam: brightcart confirmed go for 09:50 UTC.
sre_jamie: starting canary now (09:50). monitoring live.
monitoring-bot: canary observations (first 6min):
- inflight peak: 125 -> drops to 40
- gpu_util: spiked to 80%, averaged 60% for 6min
- scale_up: 3 -> 6 at 09:51
- no scale_down events during canary
- 429 rate: 0.02%
- p95 latency: 480ms

sre_jamie: looks stable. keep for the rest of the 10min and then decide.
eng-maya: after 10min canary end: metrics stayed steady, no 429 surges.

sre_jamie: action items:
- runtime-olav: roll config to prod for brightcart-pool permanently and enable 2 warm replicas (owner: olav)
- eng-maya: add automated test that replays bursty pattern to CI for future regressions
- support-liam: update ticket with steps and ask customer to monitor next 24h
- product-aya: consider adding UI toggle for warm pool in Console

runtime-olav: starting rollout to prod now. will watch for 30m post-rollback window.
support-liam: customer acknowledged and thanked the team :thumbsup:
product-aya: can we capture this as a runbook entry? i'll draft one. tag me for review.
eng-maya: putting repro script + perf graphs into the incident doc.
sre_jamie: closing thread for now — reopen if oscillation reappears. :white_check_mark:
